articles.title: Trump's Putin Diesel Deal Hits Roadblock? Russian Tanker Stalls Off US Coast Amid Legal Warnings
articles.description: Trump's surprise diesel deal with Russia has run into trouble after a tanker carrying 40,000 metric tons of Russian fuel slowed to a near standstill off the US East Coast. The Malta-flagged Agioi Fanendes had initially signalled New York as its destination, but the shipment now faces uncertainty amid warnings that Russian energy imports could violate US law. New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill has cautioned ports against accepting the cargo, while lawmakers from both parties have questioned the deal's legality. Despite the controversy, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright insists the diesel will eventually be sold on the global market, even if the tanker heads to another port. The vessel's operator says its final destination has not been decided.

articles.title: Dalit Battle: BSP and SP Intensify Their Fight for Uttar Pradesh’s Dalit Vote Bank
articles.description: The battle for Uttar Pradesh’s Dalit vote bank is intensifying ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections, with the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) and Samajwadi Party (SP) stepping up their efforts to attract Dalit voters. BSP chief Mayawati is preparing for a major show of strength in Lucknow on December 6, with the party targeting 10,000 workers from every Assembly constituency. Around 90,000 workers are reportedly being mobilised from Agra. Earlier, on November 22, Akash Anand is scheduled to address a large public meeting in Etmadpur, Agra, where the party is also expected to announce a new candidate. Meanwhile, Akhilesh Yadav’s Samajwadi Party is organising a Dalit conference in Agra on November 15, with the SP chief expected to attend as the chief guest. The party is emphasising the Dalit component of its PDA formula to challenge the BSP’s traditional support base. The report also highlights Mayawati’s demand for ballot-paper elections amid the debate over SIR. Both parties are attempting to strengthen their Dalit outreach, but the eventual electoral impact remains uncertain.

articles.title: 'EGO, RESENTMENT': Hegseth Goes NUCLEAR Over Impeachment Threat, BLASTS Massie In Furious SHOWDOWN
articles.description: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday launched a furious attack on the impeachment effort against him, branding it a “farce”, a “stunt” and a “political spectacle” driven by “ego and resentment”. Speaking at his first Pentagon press briefing since May, Hegseth accused Republican Congressman Thomas Massie of using his final days in Congress to damage President Donald Trump, the administration and the military. Massie has introduced an impeachment resolution accusing Hegseth of serious misconduct over his handling of the Iran war and other military operations involving Yemen and Venezuela. Defending his leadership, Hegseth argued that no U.S. defence secretary has ever been impeached for carrying out lawful military operations.
